prompt_record.text: The attached image is the accepted STYLE anchor. Make a new quiet editorial workflow illustration matching its graphite hand-drawn outlines, soft flat warm-ivory fills, faint paper grain, muted cyan and desaturated rose accents, restrained amber light, raised front three-quarter view and very light warm-grey background. 4:3 landscape, compact subject centred slightly above middle, calm empty bottom third for a real HTML caption. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI controls or people. Subject for workflow-compare: two equally sized and equally prominent standing picture frames placed symmetrically above a single shared source card lying flat. Each frame contains a modest original abstract arrangement with subtle different shapes, the same palette and identical brightness and visual emphasis. A faint connector joins the source card to each. Neither is the winner. No star, trophy, checkmark, score, preference highlight or brighter lighting on one side.
